captions.detailed: A vertical-lift barrier panel system featuring a rectangular, silver-colored steel wire mesh gate. The gate is housed within a black structural frame comprising two tall vertical guide columns and a top crossbeam. A separate rear column guides a counterweight block, connected via a cable and pulley system at the top. The mesh gate slides vertically along the inner tracks of the front columns, while the counterweight moves vertically in opposition.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a vertical-lift security barrier panel. The assembly should feature a rectangular wire mesh gate that slides vertically within two black side guide columns, complete with a top crossbeam, and a counterweight block in a rear column that moves vertically via a top pulley system.
captions.factory: Construct the main frame using box primitives to form two vertical guide channels, a top crossbeam, and mounting feet. Model the gate as a thin rectangular frame containing a grid of intersecting cylinders or wires for the steel mesh. Model the counterweight assembly using a solid block, a cylinder for the pulley wheel, and thin lines or cylinders for the cables. Define two prismatic joints: one for the vertical motion of the gate along the main guide columns, and another for the vertical motion of the counterweight inside its rear channel.
